confirmedFindings.title: Lock Hierarchy Violation in Supervisor Barge-In Whisper
confirmedFindings.body: Acquiring dialog mutexes in arbitrary parameter order (supervisorDialogId then agentDialogId) without canonical sorting creates a circular lock dependency deadlock when simultaneous supervisor barge-in and agent transfer events occur.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Always acquire multiple locks in consistent alphabetical or resource-ID order.
